page_note: Pure cosmological substrate page describing the King/gate of Darkness, his faculties of knowing and perceiving, the five worlds, the powers and archons. The teaching maps cosmos→cosmos throughout: scent of the five worlds, sphere of iron, thunder/clouds correspondence, sense-perception faculties of the dark king. No apostolic frame, no ecclesial overlay, no hortatory pivot, no polemic naming. The chapter enumeration ('thirty-third') is itself substratic. Heavy manuscript damage (51.4%) but extant text is uniformly cosmological-correspondential.
